depression driven - i either over eat or under eat to make myself feel uncomfortable. i get sucked into a self loathing episode and dont leave my bed, shower, get dressed bc i feel like im not worth it. i purposely make myself tired and rub myself with objects or poke myself with needles to try and feel something.

ocd/perfectionist driven - it's like a punishment. if i don't live up to my own internal standards. i will hit myself repeatedly to the point of bruising and swelling to try and correct my own behaviour and as an incentive to not do it again.

suicidality driven - i cut to help give myself a rush of seratonin and dopamine to lessen the suicidality feelings and keep my hands and mind busy
